India's defence products now sell in over eighty countries. Don't buy defence stocks before you see this.
Exports hit thirty eight thousand crore last year, up sixty three percent. From Armenia and Germany, to Guyana and Sri Lanka.
HAL builds fighter jets and helicopters, and just flew Dornier planes to Guyana. Bharat Electronics makes radars. Its exports grew thirty three percent.
Solar Industries makes explosives and rockets, with plants in Zambia and South Africa. Mazagon Dock builds submarines, and now owns a shipyard in Sri Lanka.
Bharat Dynamics makes missiles like Akash, now guarding Armenia. Cochin Shipyard built India's aircraft carrier, and green cargo ships for Norway.

Garden Reach builds warships, plus eight cargo ships for Germany. Data Patterns makes defence electronics, with zero debt. Zen makes combat simulators and anti drone systems. Paras makes optics and drones.
But here's the catch. A great business is not a cheap stock. Garden Reach and Mazagon trade near twenty eight times profit. Paras, Solar and Data Patterns, above eighty times.
And five of these ten are within four percent of their fifty two week low. Watch order books and valuations, not headlines.
